acceptanceCriteria.text: File read/stat operations following a confinement check operate on a descriptor obtained during or immediately after that check, not a re-resolved pathname (Linux: `openat2` with `RESOLVE_BENEATH|NO_SYMLINKS` or an equivalent native helper; document fallback behavior on platforms without it).

A new test replaces a checked ancestor directory with a symlink *after* authorization succeeds but *before* the read completes, and proves the operation either rejects or reads only the originally-confined object.

`src/read-governor/authorize.ts`'s `detectSymlinkEscape`/`authorizeRead` — currently unreferenced by any live call site outside its own test — is either wired into an actual MCP read dispatch path with this same descriptor-bound fix, or removed if not intended for use; dead confinement code should not remain in a security-relevant module.

issue.title: fix: bind workspace-read confinement to a verified descriptor instead of a re-checked pathname
